formulas.true_range: TR = max(high - low, abs(high - previous_close), abs(low - previous_close))
formulas.atr: ATR = Wilder moving average of True Range
formulas.sweep_high: high > prev_swing_high AND close < prev_swing_high AND upper_wick_ratio >= 0.40
formulas.sweep_low: low < prev_swing_low AND close > prev_swing_low AND lower_wick_ratio >= 0.40
formulas.low_vol_drift: 15 <= ATR percentile <= 35 AND 14 <= ADX <= 25 AND ER >= 0.20
formulas.false_upside_breakout: previous close > previous_swing_high AND current close < previous_swing_high AND upper_wick_ratio >= 0.35
formulas.false_downside_breakout: previous close < previous_swing_low AND current close > previous_swing_low AND lower_wick_ratio >= 0.35
formulas.opening_range_high: highest high of first N session bars, default first 30 minutes
formulas.opening_range_low: lowest low of first N session bars, default first 30 minutes
formulas.usd_bias: Evidence-backed label from DXY/USD basket/yields/rate expectations. R25/R26 require non-neutral bias and confidence >= 0.50.
formulas.risk_sentiment: Evidence-backed label from SPX/VIX/gold/JPY/CHF safe-haven behavior. R27/R28 require non-neutral tone and confidence >= 0.50.
formulas.cb_divergence: Evidence-backed base-vs-quote central-bank/rate-expectation divergence. R29 requires non-neutral divergence and confidence >= 0.50.
formulas.overlap_trend: session == Overlap AND HTF bias == LTF bias AND ADX >= 18 AND 25 <= ATR percentile <= 90
formulas.asia_range: session == Asia AND ADX <= 18 AND ER <= 0.25 AND ATR percentile <= 75
formulas.bull_pullback_failure: HTF bullish AND close < EMA20 AND bearish candle AND +DI > -DI AND ER slope < 0
formulas.bear_pullback_failure: HTF bearish AND close > EMA20 AND bullish candle AND -DI > +DI AND ER slope < 0
formulas.session_vwap: cumulative_sum(typical_price * tick_volume) / cumulative_sum(tick_volume) per UTC session
formulas.hurst_exponent: rolling log-log slope of price-difference standard deviation across lags 2/4/8/16; > 0.58 trend-like, < 0.42 range-like
formulas.fractal_dimension: 2 - hurst_exponent; lower values imply cleaner directional structure, higher values imply more range/chop complexity
formulas.kalman_price: one-dimensional recursive Kalman level estimate of close
formulas.garch_vol_forecast: GARCH(1,1)-style recursive volatility forecast from close returns with omega=1e-8, alpha=0.08, beta=0.90
formulas.structural_break_score: absolute difference between short-term and long-term return means divided by long-term return volatility; >= 2.5 flags a possible structural break
formulas.hmm_state: three-state hidden-state filter over trend/range/stress observation scores with transition smoothing
formulas.stat_regime_vote: ensemble majority vote across ER, ADX, Hurst, Fractal Dimension, Kalman, GARCH stress, structural break, and HMM state
formulas.stat_regime_confidence: largest ensemble vote count / total statistical voters
formulas.gap_fill_percent: abs(close - open) / gap_size if gap_size > 0 else 0
formulas.data_quality_flags: R40-WARMUP = required feature NaN / not enough bars for ATR, ADX, ER, percentiles, swings. R40-BAD-DATA = missing OHLC OR invalid OHLC OR duplicate timestamp OR zero range OR spread missing OR HTF unavailable.
formulas.commission_R: direct commission_R input OR commission_currency_per_trade / initial_risk
formulas.slippage_R: (slippage_points * symbol_point_size) / risk_distance OR direct slippage_R input
formulas.stress_adjusted_cost_R: (spread_cost_R + commission_R + slippage_R) * session_cost_multiplier * volatility_cost_multiplier * news_cost_multiplier * spread_stress_multiplier
formulas.spread_slippage_session_curve: For each session: average spread, 90th percentile spread, average estimated slippage_R, and average total_cost_R from trades.
formulas.failed_cost_percent: cost/spread/slippage/rollover blocked setup candidates / all executed-or-blocked setup candidates for the regime * 100
